subject.title: [Bug]: When openclaw sends a link with an underscore to Feishu, the full hyperlink cannot be displayed

question: Should maintainers refresh/adopt an existing conflicting fork PR, or sponsor a fresh same-repository Feishu URL-boundary fix for this issue?
rationale: The bug remains valid and narrow, but current labels plus conflicting fork candidates make another duplicate automated branch the wrong next step without maintainer ownership of the repair path.

options.title: Sponsor a fresh same-repository fix
options.body: Queue one narrow Feishu plugin fix that credits the prior attempts, preserves Markdown boundaries, and requires targeted tests plus live Feishu proof.

options.title: Adopt one fork candidate
options.body: Pick the better fork candidate, resolve conflicts, and require the same regression coverage and real Feishu behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Wait for contributor refresh
options.body: Keep this issue open without new automation until a contributor updates a candidate branch into a mergeable, proof-positive state.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a fresh same-repository fix
recommendation.body: Queue one narrow Feishu plugin fix that credits the prior attempts, preserves Markdown boundaries, and requires targeted tests plus live Feishu proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and recent Feishu outbound/runtime history make this the strongest available owner for the repair-path decision.
